scope: Independent adjudication of all AI/H1 family-to-local-input correspondence codes.
required_inputs: H2 worksheet containing protected family evidence and the registered AI/H1 payloads
instructions: Adjudicate every row; no quota, target count, sampling, or outcome information is allowed.
Check source IDs and source_id:column entries against the frozen inventory.
Approve exact_materialized or exact_derivable only when object, statistic, formula/algorithm, unit, aggregation level, T0 boundary, and construct role are identical.
Use candidate_formula_completion when a plausible exact mapping cannot yet be approved solely because source formula evidence is incomplete; this status authorizes targeted formula verification only.
Downgrade similarly named mappings with a different graph, node type, statistic, time window, population, or role to construct_mismatch.
Preserve all negative and uncertain decisions in the audit trail and disclose AI/H1 agreement.
Do not view targets, model outcomes, final dimensions/features, desired counts, Qwen/Ollama, or any model API.
